title: Loudon Live Design System
idiom: Bauhaus construction diagram / letterpress proof sheet — flat ink-on-paper, no CGI
hero_prompt: Wide ~12:5 darkened parchment backdrop. One dominant image: a letterpress compositor's layout stone with a handful of metal type sorts arranged into a sparse editorial spread — Anton-weight capitals at top, a fine serif body line below, a single amber rule separating them, and a Lissajous figure traced in pencil beside the type as logo sketch. Medium: Bauhaus ink diagram with lithograph grain, dense black on warm off-white, no wash or 3D shading. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial. Balanced presence of a male and a female hand reaching from opposite sides to adjust the type sorts. Mood: methodical studio work before the press run.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem on near-black. A single thick capital letter-form (display weight, no serifs visible — just one monumental stroke) with a Lissajous ellipse looping through its counter, rendered as flat white on black with a single amber accent line. Must survive at 24 px — no fine linework, no gradients. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
